title: Beach Heaven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perfectly positioned between Alys and Rosemary Beaches, this stylish Seacrest retreat offers the ultimate blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. With four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and designer interiors throughout, it’s thoughtfully designed for families or groups seeking both relaxation and connection. Enjoy quick access to the beach via a short stroll or complimentary tram, then return home to unwind by the Seacrest community pools or gather for sunset cocktails on the third-floor balcony with its full outdoor kitchen, dining area, and sweeping views. Inside, natural light floods the open living spaces, where granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and custom finishes create a refined yet inviting atmosphere. Two king suites, multiple lounging areas, and a private bunk room offer room for everyone to recharge in comfort. Whether biking through 30A on one of the six included adult bikes, preparing meals in the chef’s kitchen, or relaxing with a drink on the breezy porch, this home makes it easy to settle into the rhythm of coastal living.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4 - Third Floor: Single Over Double Bunk + Double Over Double Bunk
